title: Enjoy a comfortable stay near Downtown Nashville
description:
Enjoy a stay in this comfortable, clean, industrial, yet modern, studio apartment. . It offers the convenience of a central location within walking distance to popular bars and restaurants in 12 South, minutes to downtown, Belmont, Vanderbilt, and more. Experience the comforts of a home-away-from-home with a stocked kitchenette, dedicated office space, onsite laundry, queen size bed and full size pull-out couch. 
[The pool opens May 1 ☀️]

The space
•      Keypad entry
•      There’s 6 steps to walk up to front door
•      Free, on-site parking
•	1 Queen size Bed (& option of a sofa bed)
•	Smart TV
•	High speed internet
•	Dedicated office space (desk/chair)
•	Fully equipped kitchenette: 
        stove top, microwave, toaster oven, air fryer, fridge, dish washer, Keurig
•	On-site laundry facility
•	Pool (seasonal)

Guest access
You will have access (keypad entry) to the whole space, including pool and onsite laundry facility.

* You will have free parking on the premises
* There is 6 concrete steps to walk up to unit
*The on-site laundry room offers paid (via credit card) washers and dryers.
*The pool is open seasonal.

Other things to note
Convenience of location:

Walking distance to Hattie B's Hot Chicken, Cilantro Mexican Grill, ML Rose Craft Beers & Burgers, Sinema Restaurant + Bar, First Watch, Maple Street Biscuit Company, bartaco, and much more!

1min drive or 4min walk to grocery store (Publix)

8min drive  or  est. $8 Uber ride to Downtown Nashville

6min drive to Vanderbilt University

4min drive to Belmont University
